title: DeploymentEdgeContribution
description: A deployment edge linking a code/build artifact to an IaC resource that deploys/hosts it.

fromSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the source endpoint (must resolve to a SourceUnit.CodeUnit in this Bb).

toSymbol.description: SCIP symbol id of the target endpoint (must resolve to a SourceUnit.CodeUnit in this Bb).

rationale.description: How the link was established (e.g. matching image tag, container name, S3 bucket name).
